title: Welcome to the Delta
open: The sea took the world we knew. What was left of Europe lives behind a wall the engineers call the Bulwark.
voiceover: On one side, the ocean. On the other, five hundred million people. Not one meal grown in soil.
close: I'm Hamish Rannoch. The Drowned Concordat is the story of the people who keep that world fed. Book One is out now on Kindle.

title: Food from a vat
open: Imagine never tasting food that grew in the ground. Not once. Not in your whole life.
voiceover: In the Delta, breakfast is gel. Lunch is gel. Dinner is gel. Foam or lump: that's the choice.
close: The Drowned Concordat asks what you would believe in, if your next meal depended on it. Book One is out now.

title: Meet Elara
open: Doctor Elara Di Canti keeps a drowned hemisphere fed. She has never doubted that it's worth it.
voiceover: High above the flood line, the towers glow. Far below, the queues for gel never end.
close: Elara believes in the system. The Drowned Concordat is about what that belief costs. Book One, out now on Kindle.

title: Why a wall?
open: People ask me, why a wall? Because when the water came, a wall was the only promise anyone could keep.
voiceover: Storm season on the Bulwark. Every wave is a test the engineers have to pass. And the ocean is patient.
close: The Drowned Concordat. Climate fiction where the flood has already happened. Book One is out now.

title: Every calorie counted
open: In the Delta, every calorie is counted. Every gram is accounted for. And so is everyone who eats one.
voiceover: The Council keeps the Delta fed. The Enforcers keep it quiet.
close: If the oceans rose tomorrow, who would decide what you eat? The Drowned Concordat, Book One, out now.

title: Two sisters, one drowned world
open: Two sisters. One drowned world. Two very different ideas of how to save it.
voiceover: Elara feeds the Delta from a vat. Her sister Becca still believes the future grows in soil.
close: That argument sits at the heart of The Drowned Concordat. Book One is out now on Kindle.

title: When the food comes from a vat
open: Some people in the Delta have stopped trusting the numbers.
voiceover: A few have started to pray instead. When your food comes from a vat, faith has to come from somewhere else.
close: The Drowned Concordat is about food, faith, and the people who keep a drowned world alive. Book One, out now.

title: If you loved Station Eleven
open: If you love Station Eleven, The Water Knife or The Wind-Up Girl, this one is for you.
voiceover: A hard science fiction dystopia, set behind the sea walls of a flooded Europe.
close: The Drowned Concordat, Book One. Out now on Kindle. Come and see what's left.
